home.title: Ultimate — the framework where an agent writes the app
home.description: A full-stack, Bun-only web framework: Postgres, SolidJS and one gate, built so an AI agent ships a working product with fewer decisions to make.
home.headline: Fewer problems for the author to worry about.
home.lede: Ultimate is a full-stack web framework whose primary developer is an AI agent. Every decision it makes is one the agent does not have to.
home.runBody: Two commands to a running app, and one to know it is shippable:
home.runVerify: x verify is the contract: green means shippable.
home.demoBody: A social network built on it runs in production, its image published on every push.
home.whyEight: Eight primitives, closed: entity, policy, action, mutator, query, job, route, task.
home.whyErrors: Every error is a stable code, a cause and a command that fixes it.
home.whyBudget: This site ships zero JavaScript on every page but search, and its own gate refuses the first byte over.
home.whenNotBody: Not on Node or Deno, not without Postgres, and not when you want to choose your own router, ORM or component library: the point is that those are decided.
